'''Sinkhole Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]]. It was similar in appearance to [[Centerpoint Station]], but much smaller. Sinkhole Station was home to the [[Mind Walkers]], a group of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] who were able to separate their minds from their bodies in order to travel in the realm of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] known as [[beyond shadows]].

In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]] visited the station during their quest to discover more about [[Darth Caedus]]' fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. Soon after the Skywalkers arrived, a [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]] [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|strike team]] traveled to the station to [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|confront]] the Grand Master. The station was later destroyed by the dark side being known as [[Abeloth]].

==History==
It was believed by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] that the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]] were responsible for the creation of [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]], including Sinkhole Station. After the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] traveled throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for five years to train with several [[The Force/Legends|Force]] sects in hopes of gaining a greater understanding of the Force. During this sojourn, he traveled to this station, where he met with the [[Mind Walkers]], a group of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] inhabiting the station who were able to separate their minds from their physical bodies in order to travel to a realm of the Force known as [[beyond shadows]]. During his time at Sinkhole Station, Solo traveled beyond shadows with the Mind Walkers.

In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], two years after Solo's fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and transformation into the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Caedus, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] Luke Skywalker and his son, [[Ben Skywalker]], embarked on a quest to discover more about Solo's fall to the dark side. Their journey led them to Sinkhole Station, where they met with the Mind Walkers. They also found [[Qwallo Mode]], a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who had disappeared in the Maw [[41 ABY|two years earlier]] and had been presumed [[Death/Legends|dead]]. The Skywalkers learned from the Mind Walkers how to travel [[beyond shadows]]. While in the realm, Luke encountered a being called [[Abeloth]], who wished to speak with him, but Luke declined. Later, the Grand Master and his son also spoke with the spirits of [[Anakin Solo]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker]], and Jacen Solo.

Soon after the Skywalkers returned from beyond shadows, a [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|strike team]] of [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]] arrived on the station, determined to kill Luke. The Sith [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|ambushed]] the Jedi, and in the resulting battle all but one of the Sith were killed. The strike team's sole survivor, [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]], fled the station for [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], and the Skywalkers left Sinkhole in pursuit.

As Abeloth gained power, she managed to break free of her prison, obliterating the Station. Soon after, a joint Jedi and Sith strike team under the command of Skywalker and Sith [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]] embarked on a [[Mission to the Maw|mission]] to eliminate Abeloth. However, they found the station completely destroyed. Deciding to go straight to her [[Abeloth's planet|homeworld]], they noticed that the black holes surrounding the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] were moving away, and they speculated that the station may have been built by the Celestials to contain Abeloth.
